{{Vanilla|Dirt}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Dirt''' is the most common surface block. [[Matcha Flavoured]] sells it in bulk, makes it the base of [[Dirt Slab|dirt slabs]], [[mud]] and early [[Packed Mud|packed mud]], and adds it to the drops of [[gravel]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
* Broken gravel always drops 1 dirt along with 1 flint.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/gravel.json}}</ref>
* Two dirt slabs craft back into dirt, and a grass block cooked in an [[oven]] becomes dirt ({{Value|Dirt|cook_time|station=Oven}}).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/oven/dirt_from_smelting_grass_block.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 6 bulk dirt for 1 [[obol]] at the novice level; each unpacks into 64 dirt.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/1/dirt.json}}</ref> See [[Bulk blocks]].

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* One dirt and one short dry grass make [[Packed Mud|packed mud]], the material of the [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/packed_mud_from_dirt.json}}</ref>
* Eight dirt and a water bottle make 8 [[mud]].
* Two dirt and two flint make 2 [[gravel]].
* Three dirt make 6 [[Dirt Slab|dirt slabs]].
* Two dirt and two {{MCW|Leaf Litter|leaf litter}}, placed diagonally, make 2 [[podzol]]. Picking up leaf litter unlocks the recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/podzol.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/leaf_litter.json}}</ref>
